mapper.select: SELECT bucket_key AS bucketKey, resolution_domain AS resolutionDomain, stage_key AS stageKey, target_attr_key AS targetAttrKey, aggregation_mode AS aggregationMode, provisional, name, description, editor_hint::text AS editorHintJson, bucket_config::text AS bucketConfigJson FROM public.coefficient_buckets WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY resolution_domain, stage_key, bucket_key

SELECT bucket_key AS bucketKey, resolution_domain AS resolutionDomain, stage_key AS stageKey, target_attr_key AS targetAttrKey, aggregation_mode AS aggregationMode, provisional, name, description, editor_hint::text AS editorHintJson, bucket_config::text AS bucketConfigJson FROM public.coefficient_buckets WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND bucket_key = #{bucketKey}

SELECT bucket_key AS bucketKey, resolution_domain AS resolutionDomain, stage_key AS stageKey, target_attr_key AS targetAttrKey, aggregation_mode AS aggregationMode, provisional, name, description, editor_hint::text AS editorHintJson, bucket_config::text AS bucketConfigJson FROM public.coefficient_buckets WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND updated_at > #{updatedAfter} ORDER BY resolution_domain, stage_key, bucket_key
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.coefficient_buckets (game_id, bucket_key, start_version_id, end_version_id, resolution_domain, stage_key, target_attr_key, aggregation_mode, provisional, name, description, editor_hint, bucket_config, updated_at) VALUES ( #{gameId}, #{bucketKey}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{resolutionDomain}, #{stageKey}, #{targetAttrKey}, #{aggregationMode}, #{provisional}, #{name}, #{description}, CAST(#{editorHintJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{bucketConfigJson} AS jsonb), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (game_id, bucket_key) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, resolution_domain = EXCLUDED.resolution_domain, stage_key = EXCLUDED.stage_key, target_attr_key = EXCLUDED.target_attr_key, aggregation_mode = EXCLUDED.aggregation_mode, provisional = EXCLUDED.provisional, name = EXCLUDED.name, description = EXCLUDED.description, editor_hint = EXCLUDED.editor_hint, bucket_config = EXCLUDED.bucket_config, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO public.coefficient_buckets_log (game_id, bucket_key, start_version_id, end_version_id, resolution_domain, stage_key, target_attr_key, aggregation_mode, provisional, name, description, editor_hint, bucket_config) VALUES ( #{gameId}, #{bucketKey}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{resolutionDomain}, #{stageKey}, #{targetAttrKey}, #{aggregationMode}, #{provisional}, #{name}, #{description}, CAST(#{editorHintJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{bucketConfigJson} AS jsonb) ) ON CONFLICT (game_id, bucket_key, start_version_id) DO UPDATE SET end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, resolution_domain = EXCLUDED.resolution_domain, stage_key = EXCLUDED.stage_key, target_attr_key = EXCLUDED.target_attr_key, aggregation_mode = EXCLUDED.aggregation_mode, provisional = EXCLUDED.provisional, name = EXCLUDED.name, description = EXCLUDED.description, editor_hint = EXCLUDED.editor_hint, bucket_config = EXCLUDED.bucket_config
